verses.text: These were the groups of Aaron's descendants. Aaron's sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
With the help of Zadok, a descendant of Eleazar, and Ahimelech, a descendant of Ithamar, David divided them into groups for their duties.

There were more leaders among Eleazar's descendants than among Ithamar's, so they were divided this way: sixteen family heads from Eleazar's descendants, and eight family heads from Ithamar's descendants.
They divided them fairly by drawing lots, because there were officials of the holy place and officials of God among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.

The secretary Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, wrote down their names in front of the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of the priests' and Levites' families. One family was chosen by lot from Eleazar, and then one from Ithamar.
The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
This was the order in which they served when they came into the LORD's temple. They followed the rules given to them by their ancestor Aaron, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
These were the rest of Levi's descendants: From Amram's descendants came Shubael, and from Shubael's descendants came Jehdeiah.
From Rehabiah's descendants came Isshiah, the chief.
From the Izharites came Shelomoth, and from Shelomoth's descendants came Jahath.
Hebron's sons were Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
Uzziel's son was Micah, and from Micah's descendants came Shamir.
Micah's brother was Isshiah, and from Isshiah's descendants came Zechariah.
Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. Jaaziah's son was Beno.
Merari's descendants through Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
From Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
From Kish came Kish's son Jerahmeel.
Mushi's sons were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the Levites, listed by their families.

Like their relatives, the descendants of Aaron, they also drew lots in front of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the priests' and Levites' families. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.
